charger.decode: INT_OK 0x5f sets CHG_OK (b4) and CHGIN_OK (b6); DETAILS_01 low nibble 1 means charging, so the enable write did reach the charger. CNFG_06 still reads 0xec because WDTCLR is self-clearing: bits 1:0 read back zero after a kick, and the code compared the readback with 0xed, reported kick-failed and wrote CHG_EN back to 0 every cycle.

interpretation: CHG_EN was written and the charger reported charging, but the kick verification treated the self-clearing WDTCLR readback as a failure and restored CHG_EN each cycle, so charging flapped on for a moment every 5 s and the battery still discharged about 265 mA. This is a verification bug, not a charger refusal.
limits: The status bar is covered by the panic text in this photo.
The -264 mA reading is an average over a flapping charge-enable cycle and does not establish the steady charge current.
No mode restart was attempted; the CHG_DTLS 0x1 shows the charger accepts CHG_EN.
